coverage.reason: The fork runs an interactive iced Wayland window, tray item, and Hyprland overlay.
Profiles and local settings are persisted under the user's configuration directory.
The hardware helper installs a root D-Bus service and polkit actions for device writes.
The Veelox bring-up uses local hardware APIs and does not add network synchronization.
Veelox exposes ASUS WMI, platform profiles, hwmon, NVIDIA NVML, Wayland, and Hyprland interfaces.
The control center must remain operable through keyboard bindings and native Wayland input.
The fork changes privileged desktop hardware software and needs source tests plus machine read-only smoke tests.
The selected behavior is an existing upstream control center and overlay that we are adapting for Veelox.

behavior.behavior: Render a local hardware dashboard and expose it as a native Wayland window/tray application.
behavior.do_not_copy: Do not copy controls into the UI unless the Veelox inventory reports the corresponding capability.

platform.requirement: The application must use the active Wayland session rather than assuming X11.

behavior.behavior: Persist profiles locally and select only backends detected in the hardware model.
behavior.do_not_copy: Do not copy claims of charge-limit, fan, lighting, or MUX support when the Veelox model reports no matching capability.

platform.requirement: Read hwmon sensors and controls through the kernel's hwmon interface and preserve firmware ownership when no writable output exists.

behavior.behavior: Keep privileged sysfs, NVML, and HID writes behind a narrow D-Bus helper and polkit policy.
edge_states: helper restart while a device is claimed
behavior.do_not_copy: Do not copy a privileged write path into the bring-up until the read-only Veelox model proves the corresponding backend exists.

platform.requirement: Privileged operations must be mediated by polkit rather than granting the GUI direct root access.

behavior.behavior: Run the upstream workspace tests before packaging or installing the fork.
behavior.do_not_copy: Do not copy an unverified build into the installed system or bypass failed tests.

platform.requirement: The workspace test command is the reproducible source-level regression gate.
